description: Creates a scene file where none is, saves one, or saves a copy under a new path. A save of a scene open in the editor saves the editor's copy, unsaved changes included. Needs the editor connected. Operations: create: a new scene with one root node; save: save the scene as it is in the editor; save_as (needs newPath): save a copy under newPath. Default create.

projectPath.description: Absolute path to the project directory, the one holding project.godot.

rootNodeType.description: create: the root node class. Default Node.

scenePath.description: Scene file inside the project, such as "scenes/main.tscn" or "res://scenes/main.tscn".

name: scene_create
